messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Josh, the order itself is complete on our side: all three Airsquitters went out on one ShipBob shipment from Chattanooga, delivered September 2 in (address hidden). Nothing is still open to ship, and no new tracking has appeared since we last spoke.

So the only live piece is the unit you're short. That's with Abel and Georges to chase with the warehouse, and the answer comes here or to (email hidden) I don't have a date for the replacement yet and I won't guess one.
Handed to the team · Customer asked for human support; short-shipped unit needs warehouse chase and a
Done, Josh. Abel or Georges has been pinged and one of them will come into this chat. Stay here if you can, and if you step away the answer goes to (email hidden)
Please send the 3 Rd unit I need to deploy them

Understood, Josh. Sending that third Airsquitter isn't something I can release myself, a short-shipped unit has to be confirmed against the warehouse count before it goes out, and that's exactly what's with Abel and Georges now, with the tracking and the count attached.

They're on until 6pm ET today. Stay in the chat if you can, otherwise the confirmation and the ETA come to (email hidden)

Still here, Josh. The team has your case with the tracking and the unit count, and one of them will come into this chat; they're on until 6pm ET.

While you wait, one thing that helps them move fast: was the box sealed when it arrived, and did it look short-packed or damaged?
Nothing damaged, two units have been separate and I am awaiting the 3 Rd unit

Got it, Josh, two arrived in separate deliveries, nothing damaged, one unit short. That's the packing count to check, and it's exactly what the team has in front of them.

They're on until 6pm ET and will pick this up in the chat. If you step away, the confirmation and the ship date for the third unit go to (email hidden)
